title: Creme Hair Color Natural Black 1.0 Box

details.description: Nisha Creme Hair Colour is a creme-based premium hair colour without ammonia; with the benefits of sunflower, avocado, and henna extracts. These herbs ensure conditioning and colouring of hair without damaging them. This creme-based hair colour colours your grey hair and makes your hair soft, silky and stylish.
details.ingredients: Aqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Propylene Glycol, Cetyl Alcohol, Ethanolamine, P-phenylenediamine, Cetrimonium Chloride, Ceteareth-20, Glyceryl Stearate, Peg-100 Stearate, 2,4-diaminophenoxyethanol Hcl, Sodium Peg-7 Olive Oil Carboxylate, Parfum, Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil, Disodium Edta, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Titanium Dioxide, Sodium Sulfite, Ascorbic Acid, Persea Gratissima Oil, Resorcinol, Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine, Henna, Phenyl Methyl Pyrazolone. Developer: Aqua, Hydrogen Peroxide, Cetearyl Alcohol, Ceteareth-20, Glycerin, Paraffinum Liquidum, Phosphoric Acid, Pentasodium Pentetate, Sodium Stannate, Tetrasodium Pyrophosphate.
details.usageInstructions:
Mix Nisha Creme & Developer in a plastic or glass bowl.
Apply on washed and dried hair with a brush.
Leave on hair for 30 mins then rinse thoroughly with water.
Apply conditioner, wait for 3 mins, then wash.
details.manufacturerName: Prem Henna Pvt. Ltd. Plot No.
details.dangerWarnings: Hair colourants can cause severe allergic reactions. Caution: This product contains ingredients which may cause skin irritation in certain cases, so a preliminary test according to the accompanying directions should first be made. This product should not be used for dyeing eyelashes or eyebrows; such a use may cause blindness. Warning: Wear suitable gloves. Rinse eyes immediately with water if product comes in contact with them. If irritation persists, consult a doctor. Temporary 'Black Henna' tattoos may increase your risk of allergy. Do not use a hair color if you have a rash on your face or sensitive, irritated and damaged scalp, you have ever experienced any reaction after coloring your hair, or you have experienced a reaction to a temporary 'Black Henna' tattoo in the past. It is only for use on cranial (head) hair. Do not inhale or ingest. This product is not intended for use on persons under the age of 16. Skin Hypersensitivity Test: Always carry out the test 48 hours before each and every application. Cleanse a small area of skin behind the ear or the inner surface of the forearm using soap and water or alcohol, apply a small quantity of the hair dye as prepared for use and allow it to dry. After 48 hours wash the area gently with soap and water and observe. If no irritation or inflammation is apparent, it may be assumed there is no hypersensitivity to the dye. Safety: Follow the instruction leaflet inside the pack. Keep out of reach of children. Rinse hair well after application. Protect from direct sunlight and heat. Keep in a cool and dry place.
